fields.name: Registrar (ULB)
fields.description: The local Registrar appointed by the ULB under the Registration of Births and Deaths Act. Handles normal registrations and delays up to 30 days.

fields.name: District Registrar / Block Statistical Officer / Authorized Officer
fields.description: For delays >30 days to within 1 year: written permission of the District Registrar OR the Block Statistical Officer OR any other officer authorized by the Chief Registrar (Births and Deaths). Source: Rajasthan RBD (Amendment) Rules, 2025, Rule 5(b)(ii) amending Rule 9(ii) of 2000 Rules.

fields.name: Executive Officer (ULB)
fields.description: Executive Officer of the Urban Local Body.

fields.name: Chief Medical Officer
fields.description: Chief Medical Officer at district level.

fields.name: Sub-Divisional Magistrate / District Magistrate / Executive Magistrate
fields.description: For delays >1 year: order of the District Magistrate OR Sub-Divisional Magistrate OR Executive Magistrate authorized by the District Magistrate. Source: Rajasthan RBD (Amendment) Rules, 2025, Rule 5(b)(iii) amending Rule 9(iii) of 2000 Rules.

fields.name: Prescribed Authority (as notified by State Government)
fields.description: Generic designation for an authority prescribed by the State Government under the RBD Act/Rules.
